title: Chat list tabs, filters and empty states
summary: Splits the chat list into the Conversas and Grupos tabs (ADR 0053), shows group invites at the top of Grupos, and gives each empty case its own message. No filter chips (MZ decision 25 Oct 2026, bipe#592).

tab.description: chats: DMs (RoomInfo.isDm). groups: every other joined room.

groupInvites.description: groups tab only, newest first, above the list.

empty.description: Which empty message shows. none: the list has rows.

chatsBadge.description: Tab badge of Conversas: unread DMs.

groupsBadge.description: Tab badge of Grupos: unread mentions and replies in groups only (ADR 0053).

selectTab.effect: Switches the tab and sets the room list filter.

acceptInvite.effect: Joins the group, then opens chat-timeline.

declineInvite.effect: Leaves the invited group. The row goes away.

startChat.effect: From an empty Conversas: opens start chat (people issue).

notes: Filters: chats is All of Joined, NonSpace, DeduplicateVersions and Category People; groups is the same with Category Group. The Category rule follows RoomInfo.isDm (ADR 0141: one DM test), so a DM with a third member moves to groups.
ADR 0053: a group of two that is not a DM stays in groups. The self-chat shows in neither tab; it is the first item of Você.
Two DMs with one person (ADR 0141): the list keeps only the newest room; the older one is hidden, not deleted.

Cleared DMs stay hidden until a new message arrives (dm-delete spec, clearedChatHidden). Move, do not rewrite: BipeKit ClearedChats.swift, libraries/bipe clearedchats/ClearedChats.kt; rules in registries/cleared-chats.json and test-vectors/cleared-chats.json.
Requests (DM invites) never show in either tab; the requests row of chat-requests sits at the top of Conversas.
Group invite rows use bipe_group_notification_room_invite_body_with_sender with the inviter name, and Accept and Decline buttons.
Empty states: noChats is bipe_chats_empty_title, bipe_chats_empty_body and the bipe_action_start_chat button. noGroups is bipe_app_groups_empty.

No filter chips (MZ decision 25 Oct 2026, bipe#592): the Unread (Não lidas) chip is gone, so the list stays simple. No favourites, low priority or people and rooms chips either (plan section 4, ADR 0141). Unread chats show by their badge. Favourites are a row of avatars at the top of the list, not a chip (chat-list, bipe#673).
Groups badge counts what notifies in a quiet group (ADR 0026, ADR 0053): RoomInfo numUnreadMentions plus replies to the person.

Own-client swipes archive, not delete (bipe#588, chat-archive spec). Archive filtering follows newest-DM selection and is independent of cleared history. Archived access remains visible with an empty active list.
